explanation: At D2 the value depends only on the state reached: about 0-1 when S2 is shown and about 4-6 when S1 is shown. At D1 and GO it is high and rises after a reward and when the agent has lately been choosing a2: D1 is 10 after a reward (8-9 after no reward) when the agent has been choosing a2, and 7-8 after a reward (5-6 after no reward) when it has been choosing a1; GO is 1-2 lower than D1 (8 for a2 after a reward, 6-7 for a1 after a reward, 4-6 after no reward, as low as 3-4 after several losses in a row).
